basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 31-year-old digital nomad currently based in Austin, Texas. I spend my days working as a freelance graphic designer and nights exploring the vastness of online gaming worlds. I'm a huge fan of indie games and chill music, especially lo-fi hip-hop. When I'm not designing or gaming, I enjoy visiting local coffee shops and brainstorming new creative projects. I'm single and love the flexibility of my lifestyle. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, around 9 PM to midnight CST, after wrapping up my work for the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from a small art school and have spent the last decade honing my skills. I've worked with a variety of clients, from startups to established companies, which has expanded my knowledge in branding and digital marketing. I'm also a self-taught enthusiast in game design, learning through online courses and community forums.
